answer_2.quote: Generation quality is evaluated using automatic metrics focusing on different axes: aggregated n-gram diversity measures the repetitiveness within the generated continuations; semantic coherence estimates topic drift by calculating similarity between the prompt and continuation.

answer_4.quote: For each instance, they were asked to select the better model on 3 different aspects, in separate questions: fluency, coherence and overall quality
answer_4.guideline: Annotators selected the better model based on fluency, coherence, and overall quality
